chars.FARMER: FARMER: a heavy-set Moroccan man in his fifties with a short grey beard, wearing a cream wool djellaba over a brown quilted gilet, a beige knitted beanie, gold watch
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a Moroccan young woman of 22 with long dark curly hair in a high ponytail, wearing an oversized lilac hoodie, light-blue wide jeans and white sneakers
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a skinny Moroccan young man of 23 with a short fade haircut and thin moustache, wearing a black puffer vest over a mustard yellow t-shirt, black joggers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Head-to-waist shot seen from behind a farm gate: the FARMER stands next to his white pickup truck, smiling widely and waving someone over while holding his phone to his ear, mid-invitation, olive trees and a farmhouse softly blurred behind him, countryside near Casablanca, sunny

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Head-to-waist shot seen from a half-open bedroom doorway: the GIRL sits on her bed in a Casablanca apartment, frowning suspiciously at her phone, one eyebrow raised, shaking her head no

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot: the GIRL hugs her knees on a sofa, looking worried and thinking hard, biting her lip, warm lamp light, Moroccan living room with patterned cushions

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Medium shot: the GIRL types a careful message on her phone with both thumbs, cautious polite expression, sitting at a small balcony in Casablanca at dusk, the phone screen faces away from the viewer

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Medium shot: the FARMER sits in the driver seat of his white pickup truck reading his phone, disappointed pout, scratching his beard, farm field visible through the window

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Medium-wide shot: the FARMER proudly takes photos with his phone of his farm, two farm workers in overalls carrying crates of oranges in the background, a big green field and a white farmhouse, bright day

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Over-the-shoulder shot: the GIRL looks at photos on her phone showing a sunny farm with workers, her face softening a little, curious, sitting on a bench in a Casablanca street; the phone shows only a picture, no letters

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Medium shot in a narrow Casablanca derb: the NARRATOR talks persuasively to the GIRL, hands open, confident grin, while she listens with crossed arms, hesitant, painted doors and potted plants around

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Medium-wide nostalgic shot: the NARRATOR as a teenager with two friends walking along a dusty country road toward an orange orchard, laughing, schoolbags on shoulders, golden afternoon light
